rooms.name: Temple Facade
rooms.desc: A snowy ledge at the end of a gravel road, before a temple face carved fifty feet up the sheer mountainside. Six alcoves hold twenty-foot amber statues of hooded, faceless figures at prayer; between the middle two an archway opens on steps going down.
rooms.dm: The statues cannot be damaged; looking at one for long breeds unease.

rooms.name: Narrow Fissure
rooms.desc: A narrow crack in the rock west of the facade; lamplight and voices come from somewhere beyond.
rooms.dm: The fissure (2 ft wide, 10 ft tall, 15 ft deep) leads to X15. Loud noise outside brings one of the creatures there to look.

objects.desc: A twenty-foot statue of a faceless, hooded figure carved from one block of amber, hands pressed together in prayer.
objects.dm: Impervious to damage. Staring at one for long breeds unease.

objects.desc: A twenty-foot statue of a faceless, hooded figure carved from one block of amber, hands pressed together in prayer.
objects.dm: Impervious to damage. Staring at one for long breeds unease.

objects.desc: A twenty-foot statue of a faceless, hooded figure carved from one block of amber, hands pressed together in prayer.
objects.dm: Impervious to damage. Staring at one for long breeds unease.

objects.desc: A twenty-foot statue of a faceless, hooded figure carved from one block of amber, hands pressed together in prayer.
objects.dm: Impervious to damage. Staring at one for long breeds unease.

objects.desc: A twenty-foot statue of a faceless, hooded figure carved from one block of amber, hands pressed together in prayer.
objects.dm: Impervious to damage. Staring at one for long breeds unease.

objects.desc: A twenty-foot statue of a faceless, hooded figure carved from one block of amber, hands pressed together in prayer.
objects.dm: Impervious to damage. Staring at one for long breeds unease.

objects.desc: A twenty-foot archway between the two inner statues; icy steps lead down into darkness.

objects.label: The gravel road climbs north from Tsolenka Pass and fades under the snow short of the facade.
Fissure 2 ft wide, 10 ft tall, 15 ft deep, down into X15; light and voices beyond. Loud noise outside draws one of the mountain folk to look.
Party arrives up the road

rooms.name: Entrance
rooms.desc: Icy steps drop ten feet into an old, battered hall; arrow slits in its walls; a vast darkness beyond.
rooms.dm: No guards behind the slits (X2a, X2b).

rooms.name: Guard Room
rooms.desc: A bare, empty guard room behind a secret door, two arrow slits in its east wall.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 10 ft.

rooms.name: Guard Room
rooms.desc: A guard room behind a secret door, arrow slits in the west wall. A skeleton in a blue robe sits slumped in the north-east corner, clutching something.
rooms.dm: A wizard who froze to death; harmless. Treasure: wand of secrets.

rooms.name: Empty Barracks (west)
rooms.desc: A frigid room littered with splintered wood.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 10 ft. The wood was bunks. A secret door in the east wall opens into X2a.

rooms.name: Empty Barracks (east)
rooms.desc: A frigid room littered with splintered wood.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 10 ft. The wood was bunks. A secret door in the west wall opens into X2b.

rooms.name: Overlook
rooms.desc: A broad black marble balcony with a broken railing, looking out over a vast temple. Stairs at each end go down; the walls and vault glow faintly gold with amber. Doors stand shut to the west and open to the east.
rooms.dm: Vault 30 ft above. Passive Perception 12 notices the arrow slits (X8, X17). Voices behind the west doors (X15). Light reaching 90 ft shows the faceless statue (X5a).

rooms.name: Southeast Annex
rooms.desc: A bare annex with a ragged ten-foot hole in the east of its floor and empty sconces on the walls. Double doors of amber stand open north and west; a single door lies just south of them.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 20 ft. The hole: a rough shaft 20 ft down with good handholds, then a 10-ft drop into X33a; its flameskulls come up if they hear noise. Secret door south to X7.

rooms.name: Secret Scroll Repository
rooms.desc: A dusty niche-room whose south wall is bored with round holes for scrolls.
rooms.dm: The emergency scrolls kept here are dust.

rooms.name: Upper East Hall
rooms.desc: A twenty-foot-wide arched corridor seventy feet long, glazed in amber, doors open at both ends. A shut door midway along the east wall faces three arrow slits; cracks run the length of the black marble floor.
rooms.dm: The golem (X10) cracked the floor. The slits (5 in by 2 ft) look down on X5.

rooms.name: Lecture Hall
rooms.desc: A lecture hall lit by red copper lanthorns. Amber bas-reliefs of wizards with spellbooks; stairs north and south descend twenty feet past rows of red marble benches to an obsidian lectern, a slate slab hanging on chains behind it.
rooms.dm: Continual light in the lanthorns. Vilnius (mage) and his invisible quasit hide behind the lectern (passive Perception 17, DC 12 search). He eats vermin and will not leave until the golem is gone.

rooms.name: Northeast Annex
rooms.desc: A bare annex whose eastern part has fallen in. Doors stand open west and south. In the middle a ten-foot statue of a jackal-headed warrior in cracked amber turns toward you and clenches its fists.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 20 ft, empty sconces. Damaged amber golem (stone golem, 145 hp); fights while it can see anyone.

rooms.name: Northeast Balcony
rooms.desc: A black marble balcony thirty feet above the north-east corner of the temple; its two amber doors stand open.
rooms.dm: The arrow slit of X13 is west of the north doors.

rooms.name: East Shrine
rooms.desc: A bare shrine: a foyer of fallen candlesticks to the west, alcoves north and south, and in a raised alcove to the east the shattered pieces of an obsidian statue.
rooms.dm: The golem wrecked it (it showed the same nameless god). A secret door at the back of a north alcove leads to X14.

rooms.name: East Archer Post
rooms.desc: A narrow post with one arrow slit in the middle of its south wall.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 10 ft; the slit looks down under the statue's raised left arm.

rooms.name: North Staircase
rooms.desc: A dusty corridor heads north and turns east down a dark stair. The air is thin and smells of death.
rooms.dm: Three 10-ft flights with landings drop 30 ft to X14a.

rooms.name: Southwest Annex
rooms.desc: A torchlit stone annex, its floor covered in fur bedrolls. Cold air blows through a crack in the south-west wall.
rooms.dm: Helwa (gladiator) and five berserkers sharpening weapons; a dire wolf of Strahd's asleep in the middle. They fight to the death; the wolf flees east below half hp. They keep the doors to X17 shut. Secret door south to X16 (unknown to them).

rooms.name: Narrow Fissure (the crack)
rooms.desc: A tight squeeze through split rock.
rooms.dm: Two feet wide: Small creatures pass freely, Medium ones squeeze.

rooms.name: West Scroll Repository
rooms.desc: A dusty space whose south wall is bored with round holes for scrolls.
rooms.dm: As X7: the scrolls are dust.

rooms.name: Upper West Hall
rooms.desc: An arched, amber-sheathed corridor seventy feet long. The south half is scorched; a charred corpse lies under a burned fur cloak. Three skulls wreathed in green fire float in the middle of the hall.
rooms.dm: Three flameskulls; they never leave the hall. The corpse is Jakarion; his staff of frost survived (touching it brings a flaw). The arrow slits look down on X5.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc: A short bare stone hallway with an amber door at each end.
rooms.dm: X17 east, X21 west.

rooms.name: Potion Storage
rooms.desc: Dusty stone blocks like tables; the walls are carved with niches holding hundreds of dusty bottles; cobwebbed ladders lean against them.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 15 ft. Dried potions, useless. The ladders will not bear weight. Secret door north to X21.

rooms.name: Architect's Room
rooms.desc: A twelve-foot model of a dark castle of high walls and tall spires fills the room; behind it, in a corner, broken furniture and a wooden chest.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 15 ft. Artimus, the architect of Castle Ravenloft, lived here. The chest's map case is empty; a false bottom (DC 10) hides a tome of understanding. Secret door south to X21.

rooms.name: West Staircase
rooms.desc: Thick, undisturbed dust on three ten-foot flights of stairs joined by landings.
rooms.dm: Links X18 and X36. Secret doors N (X20) and S (X19) on the top landing.

rooms.name: Northwest Annex
rooms.desc: Torches light a dining table heaped with a magnificent feast: roast meat, sweet vegetables, hot gravy and wine.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 20 ft. Only the table is real; feast, chairs and torches are a programmed illusion (DC 17). A green copper ewer in the feast: lift it and the illusions end and seven specters attack its holder.

rooms.name: Northwest Balcony
rooms.desc: A black marble balcony over the north-west corner of the temple, thirty feet up; nearly half of it has fallen away and cracks run near its ragged edge.
rooms.dm: Over 250 lb collapses it (30-ft fall). The X25 arrow slit is east of the north doors.

rooms.name: West Shrine
rooms.desc: A bare shrine: candlesticks hung with cobwebs in the corners of the foyer, paired alcoves along the walls, and in a raised alcove a faceless obsidian statue. Two desiccated corpses lie before it.
rooms.dm: DC 16 Wisdom save on entering or be drawn to the statue (sympathy); the two dead wizards starved here. Covering or removing it ends the pull. A secret door in a north alcove releases a flood of skulls (X26).

rooms.name: West Archer Post
rooms.desc: A narrow post with one arrow slit in the middle of its south wall.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 10 ft; the slit looks down under the statue's raised right arm.

rooms.name: Secret Alcove
rooms.desc: Hundreds of skulls tumble out as the door opens; the space behind is packed with them, floor to ceiling.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 30 ft. Clearing a path takes 5 minutes. An iron chest is glued upside down to the ceiling (arcane lock, DC 25); opening it vanishes the floor: a 30-ft fall into X39. The chest is empty.

rooms.name: Lich's Lair
rooms.desc: A room of faded royal trappings: ornate furniture, fine rugs and tapestries, statuary, lit candelabras on little tables, all under dust and cobwebs. A decrepit skeleton in tattered robes stands in the middle, red lights burning in its eyes.
rooms.dm: Exethanter the lich (99 hp, no memory, cantrips only, CR 10): 'Do I know you?' Greater restoration restores memory (he then shares passwords, lore, command words); a second casting his hit points. Three secret doors; X28's is arcane locked ('Exethanter').

rooms.name: Hidden Phylactery
rooms.desc: A small dusty room. A scaly arm and claw rise from the floor, holding up a little box of bone.
rooms.dm: The arm is carved. The box is Exethanter's phylactery: 20 radiant damage from one source destroys it.

rooms.name: Secret Room
rooms.desc: Dust and cobwebs; nothing else.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 10 ft.

rooms.name: Preserved Library
rooms.desc: A stone library under a vaulted ceiling painted with angels burning in a hell. Six black marble bookcases ten feet tall hold hundreds of well-kept tomes; rugs, chairs and lit candelabras fill the south. A black railing rings a golden stair spiralling down a broad shaft to the north.
rooms.dm: Walls 20 ft, vault 30 ft; no ladders (the wizards used mage hand). Books need command words (the lich) or true seeing; they and the furnishings decay if removed. Secret doors W (X29) and S (stairs to X5b).

rooms.name: God of Secrets (the head)
rooms.desc: Inside the statue's hollow head: a darkness so deep the light dies in it. Two eyeholes look south over the temple.
rooms.dm: Neferon the arcanaloth lairs here in magical darkness (DC 17). The 40-ft granite statue hides a secret door at the back of its base (DC 20) and a spiral stair up to a trapdoor in this floor.

A skeleton slumped in the corner, wrapped in a faded blue robe, something clutched to its chest.
objects.dm: A wizard who froze to death; harmless.

objects.desc: Splintered wood, all that is left of the bunks.

objects.label: Black marble, railing shattered in places; stairs at each end descend 30 ft to X5. Passive Perception 12 spots the arrow slits of X8/X17. Light reaching 90 ft shows the great statue.

objects.desc: A rough-edged hole ten feet across breaks through the floor.
objects.dm: Shaft: 20 ft of easy handholds, then a 10-ft drop into X33a. Noise brings its three flameskulls up the shaft.

objects.desc: An obsidian lectern at the foot of the tiers.
A slab of black slate hanging from chains, a few old chalk marks on it.

objects.label: Vilnius (mage), burned and blistered, hiding behind the lectern; passive Perception 17 or DC 12 search to spot. Carries the shield guardian's amulet (X35).
Vilnius's invisible quasit familiar
Damaged amber golem, jackal-headed (stone golem, 145 hp); attacks anything it sees

objects.desc: Fragments of a shattered obsidian statue in the raised alcove.

objects.label: A dusty corridor north, then east down three 10-ft flights (30 ft in all) to X14a; the stench of death grows.
Helwa the gladiator, leader of the mountain folk; fights to the death
Berserker of the mountain folk, sharpening a weapon

objects.dm: Jakarion, incinerated by the flameskulls.

objects.label: Jakarion's staff of frost; first to touch it gains the flaw 'I crave power above all else'
Flameskull; will not leave the hall

Hundreds of dusty bottles: dried potions, long useless. The ladders will not bear weight.

objects.desc: A twelve-foot model of a dark castle with high walls and tall spires, sculpted from rock.
objects.dm: Artimus's model of Castle Ravenloft. A card-reading treasure here is inside it: smash in to reach it.

objects.label: Tome of understanding under the false bottom (DC 10 Perception)
Three 10-ft flights with 10-ft landings link X18 and X36; dust undisturbed for ages. Secret doors N (X20) and S (X19) on the top landing.

objects.desc: A magnificent feast: roasts, vegetables, gravy, wine.
objects.dm: Illusion (programmed illusion, DC 17), as are the chairs and torches. Only the table and the ewer are real.

objects.desc: A green copper ewer embossed with dancing bears, elks and wolves.
objects.dm: Transmutation aura. Lifting it ends the illusions and seven specters attack its holder. Turns poison to wine; fills with a gallon of wine once a day.

Unsafe: more than 250 lb collapses it; a 30-ft fall to the temple floor. The arrow slit of X25 is east of the northern doors.

objects.desc: A faceless obsidian statue, four feet tall, in a raised alcove.
objects.dm: DC 16 Wisdom save on entering or be drawn to it (sympathy). Covering or removing it ends the effect. 250 lb.

objects.desc: A desiccated corpse in tattered clothes, slumped before the statue.
Human skulls, packed floor to ceiling.
objects.dm: 5 minutes for one character to clear a path.

objects.label: Iron chest glued upside down to the 30-ft ceiling (sovereign glue, arcane lock, DC 25 Strength); opening it disintegrates the floor: 30-ft fall into X39

objects.desc: A rotted divan; a bronze-covered book lies on it in plain view.
objects.dm: The Incants of Exethanter (the lich's spellbook). The lich attacks anyone who takes it.

objects.label: Exethanter the lich (99 hp, memory lost, cantrips only, CR 10). 'Do I know you?' Greater restoration restores him.

objects.desc: A carved scaly arm rises from the floor, its claw clutching a small bone box.

objects.label: Exethanter's phylactery (the bone box): 20 radiant damage from one source destroys it

objects.desc: A ten-foot bookcase of black marble, its shelves full of tomes with blank covers.

objects.label: Every book looks blank: each needs its command word (only the restored lich knows them) or true seeing. Every PHB wizard spell is here somewhere. Taken out, a book crumbles.
Vaulted ceiling 30 ft up: a fresco of angels set ablaze in a hell.

objects.desc: The great statue's cowled head, its face a void of utter blackness pierced by two eyeholes.
A stone trapdoor in the floor of the head.

objects.label: Neferon the arcanaloth in magical darkness (DC 17); truesight. Disguises as 'Heinrich Stolt'. Flees invisibly below half hp; never leaves the temple.
Neferon's spellbook, gold spectacles with pink lenses (250 gp), robe of useful items (8 patches). A card-reading treasure lies on this floor.
Eyeholes 2 ft wide see the temple floor south of the statue and the balcony X4, nothing behind or above; three-quarters cover.

rooms.name: Temple of Lost Secrets
rooms.desc: A vast temple of black marble under amber-sheathed walls: four black columns, a towering cowled statue at the north end, arched halls leading west and east past white marble wizards in alcoves, one fallen. A broken balcony lies in pieces before an open doorway.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 60 ft; stairs and the balconies X4, X11, X23 are 30 ft up. Neferon attacks from the statue's head; the three flameskulls of X17 join in from the slits (three-quarters cover). Rahadin's Prayer happens here.

rooms.name: Secret Door (stair to the library)
rooms.desc: A dusty stone staircase behind the temple's north wall, climbing toward the library.
rooms.dm: The secret door (DC 20) is arcane locked: knocking three times opens it for a minute. 30 ft up a second secret door opens itself for anyone within 5 ft (X30).

rooms.name: Locked Doors
rooms.desc: A pair of amber doors in the temple's south wall, sealed tight.
rooms.dm: Arcane lock; password 'Etherna'. DC 25 Strength or AC 15, 60 hp. Smashing them fills the 30-ft cube to the north with necrotic energy (4d10). The catacombs (X31) lie beyond.

rooms.name: Amber Reflections (west hall)
rooms.desc: An arched hall twenty feet high. Your reflections in the amber do not mirror you: they wave and scream without a sound.
rooms.dm: Illusions (DC 15). Leads to X36.

rooms.name: Amber Reflections (east hall)
rooms.desc: An arched hall twenty feet high. Your reflections in the amber do not mirror you: they wave and scream without a sound.
rooms.dm: Illusions (DC 15). Leads to X32.

rooms.name: Plundered Treasury
rooms.desc: A great stone room whose amber doors lie smashed among crushed bones, armour and weapons.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 30 ft. The golem that guarded it went upstairs (X10). Four poltergeists of dead thieves cannot leave and fight until destroyed.

rooms.name: Sealed Treasury
rooms.desc: Heaps of treasure against the west and east walls; a ten-foot amber statue of a hawk-headed warrior stands in a wide alcove to the north, a crack in the wall behind it.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 30 ft. Doors arcane locked ('Dhaviton'); smashing them makes the golem invisible for a minute. The golem attacks anyone who disturbs the treasure.

rooms.name: Fissure
rooms.desc: Two natural cracks, side by side, split the rock.
rooms.dm: Each 3 ft wide, 8 ft high, 10 ft long, between X40 and X42.

rooms.name: Amber Vault
rooms.desc: A golden marble stair with a black railing spirals up a broad shaft along the north wall. Six rotting crates lie in the middle; the amber walls are sculpted as tentacles gripping reliefs of kings and queens. Tall rough blocks of amber stand in the alcoves; cracks in the south wall have spilled rubble.
rooms.dm: Six vampire spawn burst from the crates at intruders. West: the Vampyr; south: Tenebrous; east: Zhudun (Kasimir's goal). The spiral climbs 30 ft to X30.

rooms.name: Lower West Hall
rooms.desc: An enormous hall coated in amber like sculpted honey, dust on black marble, a vault twenty-five feet up. Ledges five feet up hold life-size alabaster animals; many have fallen and shattered.
rooms.dm: The animals are familiars, harmless. The north door stands open; four others are shut.

rooms.name: Wizard's Bedchamber
rooms.desc: Furnishings of ancient, colourless wood have collapsed under their own weight, deep in dust and cobwebs.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 10 ft.

rooms.name: Haunted Room
rooms.desc: A wrecked bedchamber: the remains of a bed, wardrobe, trunks, tall candlesticks, a desk, a bookshelf and chairs, with torn books, quills and old clothes everywhere.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 10 ft. A poltergeist throws the wreckage. A search finds a scroll tube: spell scroll of wall of fire.

rooms.name: West Staircase (flights and landings)
rooms.desc: Thick, undisturbed dust on the lower flights of the west stair.
rooms.dm: Down to X36.

rooms.name: Lower East Hall
rooms.desc: A great hall of amber that glistens like honey, dust on the black marble floor; its north end is a wall of rubble. Three ugly women in tattered black gowns and pointed hats stand before the south door with brooms.
rooms.dm: Three Barovian witches trying passwords on X33a (they never thought of the shaft from X6); they loose three brooms of animated attack. With two down, the third flies off on her broom.

rooms.name: Wizard's Bedchamber
rooms.desc: A white marble bed in a bare stone room, golden hawks on its posts; the rest of the furniture is dusty heaps. Cobwebs hang over sigils cut into the walls.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 10 ft. The sigils were wards, now spent. Four golden hawks, 250 gp each.

rooms.name: Sleeping Guardian
rooms.desc: Decayed furniture around a man-shaped construct of dark wood and riveted iron, its helmed head scraping the ceiling, cobwebs running from it to the wreckage.
rooms.dm: An incapacitated shield guardian; its control amulet is on Vilnius (X9).

rooms.name: Collapsed Lower Hall
rooms.desc: A high, amber-glazed hall half buried in fallen stone; a path through the rubble leads to an open doorway that breathes a deathly stench.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 25 ft; once joined X32. Unless the party is dark and quiet, the ghasts in X33c hear them coming.

rooms.name: North Staircase (flights and landings)
rooms.desc: The last flights of a dark stair, the stench of death rising.
rooms.dm: Down to X14a.

rooms.name: Vault of Shalx
rooms.desc: Amber walls, a red marble floor, a rough shaft in the middle of the ceiling. Three amber blocks stand in alcoves, each with a skull wreathed in green flame floating above it.
rooms.dm: Three flameskulls. Door arcane locked (Shalx). Shaft 10 ft wide, easy climb, to X6.

rooms.name: Vault of Maverus
rooms.desc: Amber walls, a blue marble floor, three amber blocks in alcoves.
rooms.dm: Ceiling 10 ft. Door arcane locked (Maverus).

rooms.name: Ghastly Vault
rooms.desc: The door hangs open and the room stinks of death. Dark green marble; three amber blocks in alcoves. Two gray, three-eyed feral things stare at you hungrily; more cling to the walls and ceiling.
rooms.dm: Seven ghasts with spider climb; they fight to the death.

rooms.name: Breached Vault
rooms.desc: The door hangs open. Purplish-black marble; two amber blocks in the west and east alcoves, the third lies shattered. Four hunched one-eyed creatures cluster in the middle.
rooms.dm: Four nothics: they pry with Weird Insight and fight only if one is attacked or a sarcophagus is threatened.

rooms.name: Vault of Harkotha
rooms.desc: Amber walls, black marble veined with red, three amber blocks in alcoves.
rooms.dm: A death slaad stands invisible in the middle, greatsword ready; it attacks on entry. Door arcane locked (Harkotha).

rooms.name: Vault of Thangob
rooms.desc: Amber walls, gray marble veined with black, three amber blocks in alcoves.
rooms.dm: Door arcane locked (Thangob).

rooms.name: Central Catacombs
rooms.desc: The reek of the ancient dead. Stone niches hold human-shaped husks of amber, bones and rotten shrouds; tall iron candlesticks stand in alcoves, and their candles flare to life as you enter.
rooms.dm: Later, corrupted wizards smashed the amber and robbed the dead. The candles light for living creatures and melt if taken.

rooms.name: West Catacombs
rooms.desc: More niches of bones and smashed amber husks.

rooms.name: East Catacombs
rooms.desc: Empty niches under a thick coat of dust.
rooms.dm: No one was ever laid here.

objects.label: Secret door mid north wall (DC 20; arcane lock: knock three times, it opens for 1 minute)
Secret door at the back of the statue's base (DC 20): a spiral stair climbs to a trapdoor in the head

objects.desc: A forty-foot granite statue of a cowled figure in flowing robes, hands outstretched as if casting a spell; its face is utter blackness.
A column of black marble.
A wide black marble staircase climbing 30 ft to the southern balcony.
An eight-foot statue of a robed wizard in white marble, pointed hat, golden staff.
objects.dm: The staffs are wrought iron under peeling gold paint.

objects.desc: An eight-foot statue of a robed wizard in white marble, pointed hat, golden staff.
objects.dm: The staffs are wrought iron under peeling gold paint.

objects.desc: An eight-foot statue of a robed wizard in white marble, pointed hat, golden staff.
objects.dm: The staffs are wrought iron under peeling gold paint.

objects.desc: A white marble wizard statue toppled and shattered on the floor.
objects.dm: An earth tremor brought down the wall of its alcove.

objects.desc: Broken slabs of black marble, fallen from the balcony above, before an open doorway.
A dusty stone staircase climbing north.
